label: Tencent Design Ardot Desktop MCP
notes: Port 50501 is the default and may change when occupied. First login requires network access. Live verification used a new cloud-backed draft because this MCP version does not expose design-file creation or a confirmed local-file creation tool.

file.create.notes: MCP 1.0.11 exposes create_new_page inside an open file, not design-file creation. Create the file in Ardot UI, then reconnect MCP.

component.map.notes: No native Code Connect-style mapping tool was exposed. Match Ardot component IDs to local code in project documentation or Storybook.

diagram.create.notes: Build named frames, shapes, text, and lines on the design canvas; no native diagram tool was exposed.

whiteboard.edit.notes: Emulate a board with canvas primitives. This is not a native FigJam-equivalent mode.

slides.edit.notes: Lay out slide frames on one page and export PPTX through export_nodes; no dedicated slide-authoring MCP tool was exposed.

motion.read.notes: The verified MCP tool catalog exposed no motion, animation, transition, or prototype-context tool.

motion.write.notes: The verified MCP tool catalog exposed no motion, animation, transition, or prototype-write tool.
